description: This file defines the DirectorySelectionFragment class, an Android Fragment that demonstrates how to use the Directory Selection API. It handles directory browsing and creation within an Android app, managing user interactions, content resolution, and UI updates related to directory entries.

classes.name: DirectorySelectionFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that enables directory browsing and creation using the Directory Selection API. It manages UI components, handles user interactions for opening directories and creating new ones, and displays directory contents.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment; currently a placeholder with no additional setup.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components, click listeners for opening directory picker and creating directories, and initializes RecyclerView.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the directory picker, updating the displayed directory contents.

methods.name: updateDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Updates the current directory URI and its entries, querying content resolver for directory and child entries, and updating RecyclerView.

methods.name: createDirectory
methods.description: Creates a new directory under the specified URI with the provided name via DocumentsContract API.

methods.name: closeQuietly
methods.description: Safely closes an AutoCloseable resource, ignoring exceptions except rethrowing RuntimeExceptions.
